_comment: Which message namespaces SafeSiso staff may edit in the CMS without a developer.
Single source of truth: read by lib/cms.ts (TypeScript) and by the export and
check scripts (plain Node), so the two can never drift apart.
IN: content that legitimately changes with the programme — new questions, new
press coverage, new safe spaces, refreshed narrative copy.
legal   — Privacy and Terms need PPAG/UNFPA sign-off. A CMS would let someone
change what SafeSiso promises about a minor's data with no review
safety  — the page that tells a girl what the service can and cannot do, and
what happens if it thinks she is in danger. Same reasoning as legal:
an edit here is a safety change, not a copy change.
common  — navigation, buttons, footer. UI microcopy in a CMS breaks layouts,
and it is the one namespace every page depends on.
contact, get-involved — form labels and validation messages, which are wired
to server-side code that expects them.
portal  — partner-facing, behind auth, changes with the code that renders it.
Moving a namespace into this list is a decision about who can change what
_note: These are MESSAGE NAMESPACE keys, not filenames. Most files hold one
namespace of the same name, but not all: how-it-works.json holds
